name: Gender Equality
pron: Stress in three-syllable adjectives and verbs

notes.title: Câu bị động với động từ khuyết thiếu (Passive voice with modals)
notes.body:
Cấu trúc: S + modal (can/could/may/might/must/should/will/ought to/have to) + BE + V3/ed (+ by O).
Phủ định: S + modal + NOT + be + V3. Nghi vấn: Modal + S + be + V3?
Chuyển chủ động → bị động: tân ngữ của câu chủ động lên làm chủ ngữ; giữ nguyên động từ khuyết thiếu; thêm 'be'; động từ chính chuyển sang V3. 'by + người thực hiện' thường bỏ khi không quan trọng (people, they, someone...).
Ví dụ:
- Girls mustn't be kept home in today's world. (Getting Started)
- Boys and girls should be treated equally and given the same job opportunities.
- In some countries girls may not be allowed to be pilots.
- We must eliminate discrimination. → Discrimination must be eliminated.
- Employers should pay women fairly. → Women should be paid fairly.
Lỗi hay gặp: quên 'be' (should treated ✗), dùng 'been' sau modal (must been done ✗), dùng V-ing (should be giving ✗ khi nghĩa bị động), chia 'be' (can is done ✗). Sau modal luôn là 'be' nguyên mẫu.

notes.title: Trọng âm từ ba âm tiết: tính từ và động từ
notes.body:
Tính từ 3 âm tiết: thường nhấn âm 1: 'beautiful, 'dangerous, 'difficult, 'wonderful, 'positive, 'confident. Nếu âm 1 là tiền tố/âm yếu (/ɪ/, /ə/) thì nhấn âm 2: im'portant, e'normous, at'tractive, de'licious, e'ffective.
Động từ 3 âm tiết: nếu âm cuối chứa nguyên âm dài/đôi hoặc kết thúc bằng hơn một phụ âm thì thường nhấn âm cuối: ˌunder'stand, ˌenter'tain, ˌintro'duce; nếu âm cuối yếu thì nhấn âm 2: de'velop, en'courage, re'member, dis'cover, de'termine.
Ngoại lệ hay gặp: động từ tận cùng -ate, -ise/-ize thường nhấn âm 1: 'celebrate, 'educate, 'organise, 'recognise.
Mẹo: phát âm to từng từ, tìm âm có nguyên âm mạnh; so sánh 4 từ theo cùng từ loại.

notes.title: Collocation / cụm từ cần nhớ
notes.body:
- gender equality / gender gap / gender discrimination: bình đẳng giới / khoảng cách giới / phân biệt giới tính
- equal (job) opportunities; equal pay for equal work; equal rights
- be treated equally / fairly: được đối xử bình đẳng / công bằng
- discriminate against sb: phân biệt đối xử với ai
- encourage sb to do sth; allow sb to do sth; force sb to do sth; prevent sb from doing sth
- physical strength: sức mạnh thể chất; male-dominated job: nghề do nam giới chiếm ưu thế
- enrol in a course/school; eliminate discrimination; take up a job/hobby
- Word family: equal (adj) – equality (n) – equally (adv); discriminate (v) – discrimination (n); achieve (v) – achievement (n)
- Everyday English (đồng ý/không đồng ý): I couldn't agree more. / I totally agree. / I'm afraid I disagree. / I see your point, but...

notes.title: Mẹo làm bài
notes.body:
- Thấy chủ ngữ là vật/người CHỊU tác động (housework, girls, discrimination...) + modal → nghĩ ngay đến 'modal + be + V3'.
- Câu viết lại: giữ nguyên modal và thì; kiểm tra phủ định (must not ≠ needn't).
- Tìm lỗi sai: soát 'be' sau modal, dạng V3 (given, paid, held), từ loại (equal/equally, discriminate/discrimination).
- Trọng âm: tách riêng tính từ, động từ; nhớ nhóm -ate/-ise nhấn âm 1.
- Đọc điền từ: chú ý collocation (equal pay, gender gap, take sth seriously, such as) và cấu trúc allow/encourage sb to V.

vocab.ex: People should not be judged by their gender.
Gender equality means men and women have the same rights.
Our school club promotes gender equality.
Men and women should have equal rights.
Boys and girls should be treated equally.
Boys and girls should be given the same job opportunities.
Women now have more opportunities to study abroad.
I've always wanted to be a surgeon, so I'll go to medical school.
My dream is to become an airline pilot.
I think I'll be a kindergarten teacher.
Everyone should be treated fairly at work.
Boys and girls are encouraged to do the jobs they want.
In some countries girls may not be allowed to be pilots.
Gender discrimination at work must be stopped.
Employers must not discriminate against women.
More girls now enrol in engineering courses.
We must work together to eliminate gender discrimination.
Some jobs require a lot of physical strength.
The gender gap in pay is getting smaller.
Women make up nearly half of the workforce.
Women's wages are still lower than men's in many places.
We support equal pay for equal work.
Women in Viet Nam have the right to vote.
Girls shouldn't be forced to leave school early.
Housework should be shared by all family members.
'Boys don't cry' is a gender stereotype.

vocab.vi: do nam giới chiếm ưu thế
vocab.ex: Engineering used to be a male-dominated field.
She wants a career in medicine.
More women are becoming firefighters.
My aunt works as a car mechanic.
Men can also work as secretaries.

vocab.vi: bắt đầu (một công việc, sở thích)
vocab.ex: She took up flying lessons at the age of 18.
She dreams of becoming an astronaut.

vocab.vi: nhà du hành vũ trụ (Liên Xô/Nga)
vocab.ex: Valentina Tereshkova was a Soviet cosmonaut.
Flying into space was a great achievement.
She was determined to become a pilot.
Companies should hire staff based on their skills.
The number of female engineers is growing.
She plays for a professional football club.
The women's team won the regional tournament.

passages.title: Gender equality at work
passages.text: Gender equality means that men and women have the same rights and (1) _____ in all areas of life. In the past, many jobs such as pilot, surgeon or engineer were considered to be men's jobs, and women were rarely (2) _____ to do them. Today, the situation has changed a lot. More and more women work in fields (3) _____ used to be dominated by men, and many men have become nurses or kindergarten teachers. However, there is still a gender (4) _____ in pay in many countries: women often earn less than men for doing the same work. To solve this problem, governments should make laws to protect women's rights, and companies should (5) _____ staff based on their skills, not their gender. When everyone is treated fairly, society can benefit from the talents of all its members.

passages.title: Women's football
passages.text: Women's football has a long history, but for many years it was not taken (6) _____. In some countries, women were even banned from playing on official pitches. Things began to change in the 1970s, and the first FIFA Women's World Cup (7) _____ in China in 1991. Since then, the game has grown quickly. Today, millions of girls around the world play football, and top players (8) _____ as Megan Rapinoe have become famous role models. In Viet Nam, the women's national team has won many regional titles and (9) _____ for the 2023 FIFA Women's World Cup – the first World Cup in its history. Their success shows that football is not only a sport for men. However, female players still receive much lower salaries than male players. Many people believe that women footballers should (10) _____ fairly and paid what they deserve.

questions.q: A _____ is a doctor who performs operations in a hospital.
questions.explain: surgeon = bác sĩ phẫu thuật, người thực hiện ca mổ. nurse: y tá; pilot: phi công; mechanic: thợ máy.

questions.q: Lan wants to become an airline _____ because she loves flying.
questions.explain: airline pilot = phi công hãng hàng không, hợp với 'loves flying'. Các từ còn lại không liên quan đến bay.

questions.q:
Choose the word CLOSEST in meaning to the underlined word.
Many women still face <u>discrimination</u> at work.
questions.explain: discrimination = sự phân biệt đối xử ≈ unfair treatment (sự đối xử bất công). equal treatment mang nghĩa ngược lại.

questions.q: Girls should be _____ to follow their dreams of studying science and technology.
questions.explain: be encouraged to do sth = được khuyến khích làm gì. discouraged/prevented đi với 'from + V-ing'; banned không đi với 'to V' theo nghĩa này và trái ý câu.

questions.q: Men and women should receive equal _____ for equal work.
questions.explain: Cụm cố định 'equal pay for equal work' = trả lương ngang nhau cho công việc như nhau. price/cost/fee là giá cả, chi phí, lệ phí.

questions.q: In the past, women were not allowed to _____ in universities in some countries.
questions.explain: enrol in a university = đăng kí nhập học vào đại học. employ: thuê; eliminate: loại bỏ; encourage: khuyến khích – không hợp nghĩa và cấu trúc.

questions.q: We must work together to _____ gender discrimination in the workplace.
questions.explain: eliminate discrimination = xoá bỏ sự phân biệt đối xử. develop/create/increase (phát triển/tạo ra/tăng) ngược ý câu.

questions.q: The gender _____ in pay between men and women is getting smaller.
questions.explain: gender gap = khoảng cách (chênh lệch) giới. hole/space/break không kết hợp với gender theo nghĩa này.

questions.q: Gender _____ means that men and women have the same rights and opportunities.
questions.explain: Sau 'gender' cần danh từ tạo cụm 'gender equality' (bình đẳng giới). equal: tính từ; equally: trạng từ; equalise: động từ.

questions.q: Boys and girls should be treated _____ at school.
questions.explain: Bổ nghĩa cho động từ 'be treated' cần trạng từ equally (một cách bình đẳng).

questions.q: Some employers still _____ against women when they choose new staff.
questions.explain: Sau chủ ngữ 'Some employers' + still cần động từ: discriminate against sb = phân biệt đối xử với ai. Các phương án khác là danh từ/tính từ.

questions.q: Firefighters have to carry heavy equipment, so they need a lot of _____ strength.
questions.explain: Trước danh từ 'strength' cần tính từ: physical strength = sức mạnh thể chất. physics: môn vật lí; physician: bác sĩ; physically: trạng từ.

questions.q:
Choose the word OPPOSITE in meaning to the underlined word.
Men and women should have <u>equal</u> rights in all areas of life.
questions.explain: equal (ngang bằng) trái nghĩa với unequal (không ngang bằng). identical/similar gần nghĩa; fair (công bằng) cũng gần nghĩa.

questions.q:
Choose the word CLOSEST in meaning to the underlined word.
Many companies now <u>hire</u> both men and women as engineers.
questions.explain: hire = thuê, tuyển dụng ≈ employ. dismiss: sa thải (trái nghĩa); train: đào tạo; pay: trả lương.

questions.q: She wants to _____ flying lessons so that she can become a pilot one day.
questions.explain: take up sth = bắt đầu học/làm gì. take off: cất cánh, cởi ra; take after: giống (người thân); take over: tiếp quản.

questions.q: It is unfair that in some places girls are _____ to leave school early to do housework.
questions.explain: be forced to do sth = bị ép làm gì, hợp với 'unfair'. prevented/stopped đi với 'from + V-ing'; kept đi với 'V-ing' hoặc 'from + V-ing', không đi với 'to V'.

questions.q: Valentina Tereshkova was the first woman to travel into space. She was a Soviet _____.
questions.explain: cosmonaut = nhà du hành vũ trụ của Liên Xô/Nga. Bài nghe của Unit nói về người phụ nữ đầu tiên bay vào vũ trụ.

questions.q: Flying into space in 1963 was a remarkable _____ for a young woman.
questions.explain: Sau tính từ 'remarkable' và mạo từ 'a' cần danh từ chỉ sự việc: achievement (thành tựu). achiever là danh từ chỉ người, không hợp nghĩa 'flying into space was...'.

questions.q: Old-fashioned _____ such as 'boys don't cry' or 'girls are bad at maths' can limit children's choices.
questions.explain: stereotypes = định kiến/khuôn mẫu; các ví dụ trong ngoặc là định kiến giới. opportunities/rights/achievements không hợp nghĩa.

questions.q: My cousin is a _____ teacher. He takes care of children aged three to five.
questions.explain: Trẻ 3–5 tuổi học mẫu giáo → kindergarten teacher (giáo viên mẫu giáo), như trong Getting Started.

questions.q: Boys and girls should _____ equally.
questions.explain: Bị động với modal: should + be + V3. Boys and girls là đối tượng được đối xử → should be treated (nên được đối xử bình đẳng).

questions.q: Women _____ to work in any field they choose.
questions.explain: Phụ nữ được cho phép → bị động: should be allowed to V. 'should allowed' thiếu be; 'should allow' là chủ động, sai nghĩa.

questions.q: Gender discrimination at work must _____.
questions.explain: Sự phân biệt đối xử bị xoá bỏ → must be eliminated (phải được xoá bỏ).

questions.q: The passive voice with modals has the structure: S + modal + _____ + past participle.
questions.explain: Sau modal luôn dùng động từ nguyên mẫu không 'to' → be. Cấu trúc: S + modal + be + V3.

questions.q: In today's world, girls _____ from going to school because of their gender.
questions.explain: Girls là người bị ngăn cản → bị động phủ định: mustn't be + V3 (prevented). Câu: Ngày nay, các em gái không được bị ngăn cản đến trường vì giới tính.

questions.q: Equal job opportunities _____ to everyone, regardless of gender.
questions.explain: Cơ hội việc làm được trao → should be given (V3 của give là given).

questions.q: I believe more women _____ to take leadership positions in the future.
questions.explain: Phụ nữ được khuyến khích → bị động tương lai: will be encouraged. 'will encourage to take' thiếu tân ngữ và sai nghĩa.

questions.q: A woman _____ less than a man for doing the same job.
questions.explain: Người phụ nữ được trả lương → shouldn't be paid (không nên bị trả lương thấp hơn). Sau modal không dùng 'been'; sau be phải là V3.

questions.q: We can solve this problem easily. → This problem _____ easily.
questions.explain: Chuyển sang bị động: giữ modal can + be + V3 (solved).

questions.q: People must respect women's rights. → Women's rights _____.
questions.explain: Tân ngữ women's rights lên làm chủ ngữ; must + be + respected; bỏ 'by people'.

questions.q: Parents should not force children to do jobs they don't like. → Children _____ to do jobs they don't like.
questions.explain: Bị động phủ định: should not + be + V3 (forced); 'be forced to V' = bị ép làm gì.

questions.q: Housework _____ by all members of the family, not just women.
questions.explain: Có 'by all members' → bị động: should be shared (việc nhà nên được chia sẻ).

questions.q: Do you think more women _____ as pilots by airlines in the future?
questions.explain: Phụ nữ được các hãng hàng không tuyển dụng ('by airlines') → bị động: will be hired.

questions.q: _____ girls be allowed to play football at school?
questions.explain: Câu hỏi bị động với modal: Modal + S + be + V3? → Should girls be allowed...? Do/Are/Have không đứng trước 'be' nguyên mẫu.

questions.q: The results of our survey on gender equality _____ next week, so we can't discuss them now.
questions.explain: Kết quả được công bố, mốc 'next week' → bị động tương lai: will be announced. Các phương án còn lại là chủ động, sai nghĩa.

questions.q: This job _____ by both men and women.
questions.explain: Có 'by both men and women' → bị động: can be done (có thể được làm).

questions.q: The first FIFA Women's World Cup _____ in China in 1991.
questions.explain: Sự kiện trong quá khứ (in 1991), giải đấu được tổ chức → bị động quá khứ đơn: was held.

questions.q: Some people think that housework _____ only by women, but I disagree.
questions.explain: Việc nhà được làm bởi phụ nữ → should be done.

questions.q: Women's football matches _____ on TV more often to attract more fans.
questions.explain: Trận đấu được chiếu → should be shown (V3 của show là shown).

questions.q: Gender equality _____ without the support of both men and women.
questions.explain: Bình đẳng giới được đạt tới → bị động phủ định: cannot be achieved (không thể đạt được nếu thiếu sự ủng hộ của cả nam và nữ).

questions.topic: Stress in three-syllable adjectives and verbs
questions.q: Choose the word whose underlined part is pronounced differently from the others.
questions.explain: gender /ˈdʒendə(r)/ – g đọc /dʒ/; gap /ɡæp/, goal /ɡəʊl/, game /ɡeɪm/ – g đọc /ɡ/.

questions.topic: Stress in three-syllable adjectives and verbs
questions.q: Choose the word whose underlined part is pronounced differently from the others.
questions.explain: treated /ˈtriːtɪd/ – đuôi -ed đọc /ɪd/ (sau /t/); allowed /əˈlaʊd/, encouraged /ɪnˈkʌrɪdʒd/, enrolled /ɪnˈrəʊld/ – đọc /d/.

questions.topic: Stress in three-syllable adjectives and verbs
questions.q: Choose the word whose underlined part is pronounced differently from the others.
questions.explain: health /helθ/ – ea đọc /e/; treat /triːt/, mean /miːn/, leader /ˈliːdə(r)/ – ea đọc /iː/.

questions.topic: Stress in three-syllable adjectives and verbs
questions.q: Choose the word whose underlined part is pronounced differently from the others.
questions.explain: country /ˈkʌntri/ – ou đọc /ʌ/; housework /ˈhaʊswɜːk/, about /əˈbaʊt/, ground /ɡraʊnd/ – ou đọc /aʊ/.

questions.topic: Stress in three-syllable adjectives and verbs
questions.q: Choose the word whose underlined part is pronounced differently from the others.
questions.explain: surgeons /ˈsɜːdʒənz/ – s đọc /z/ (sau âm hữu thanh /n/); rights /raɪts/, pilots /ˈpaɪləts/, astronauts /ˈæstrənɔːts/ – s đọc /s/ (sau /t/).

questions.topic: Stress in three-syllable adjectives and verbs
questions.q: Choose the word whose underlined part is pronounced differently from the others.
questions.explain: gap /ɡæp/ – a đọc /æ/; wage /weɪdʒ/, male /meɪl/, same /seɪm/ – a đọc /eɪ/.

questions.topic: Stress in three-syllable adjectives and verbs
questions.q: Choose the word whose underlined part is pronounced differently from the others.
questions.explain: mechanic /məˈkænɪk/ – ch đọc /k/; child /tʃaɪld/, choice /tʃɔɪs/, achieve /əˈtʃiːv/ – ch đọc /tʃ/.

questions.topic: Stress in three-syllable adjectives and verbs
questions.q: Choose the word that differs from the others in the position of primary stress.
questions.explain: important /ɪmˈpɔːtnt/ nhấn âm 2; dangerous /ˈdeɪndʒərəs/, beautiful /ˈbjuːtɪfl/, difficult /ˈdɪfɪkəlt/ nhấn âm 1 (tính từ 3 âm tiết thường nhấn âm đầu).

questions.topic: Stress in three-syllable adjectives and verbs
questions.q: Choose the word that differs from the others in the position of primary stress.
questions.explain: organise /ˈɔːɡənaɪz/ nhấn âm 1 (động từ đuôi -ise); develop /dɪˈveləp/, encourage /ɪnˈkʌrɪdʒ/, remember /rɪˈmembə(r)/ nhấn âm 2.

questions.topic: Stress in three-syllable adjectives and verbs
questions.q: Choose the word that differs from the others in the position of primary stress.
questions.explain: determine /dɪˈtɜːmɪn/ nhấn âm 2; celebrate /ˈselɪbreɪt/, recognise /ˈrekəɡnaɪz/, educate /ˈedʒukeɪt/ nhấn âm 1 (đuôi -ate/-ise).

questions.topic: Stress in three-syllable adjectives and verbs
questions.q: Choose the word that differs from the others in the position of primary stress.
questions.explain: wonderful /ˈwʌndəfl/ nhấn âm 1; enormous /ɪˈnɔːməs/, attractive /əˈtræktɪv/, delicious /dɪˈlɪʃəs/ nhấn âm 2 (âm đầu yếu).

questions.topic: Stress in three-syllable adjectives and verbs
questions.q: Choose the word that differs from the others in the position of primary stress.
questions.explain: discover /dɪˈskʌvə(r)/ nhấn âm 2; understand /ˌʌndəˈstænd/, entertain /ˌentəˈteɪn/, introduce /ˌɪntrəˈdjuːs/ nhấn âm 3 (âm cuối mạnh).

questions.q:
Find the underlined part that needs correction.
Girls <u>should</u> (A) <u>be give</u> (B) the same <u>opportunities</u> (C) <u>as</u> (D) boys.
questions.explain: Lỗi ở B: sau 'be' phải dùng V3 → be given. Câu đúng: Girls should be given the same opportunities as boys.

questions.q:
Find the underlined part that needs correction.
Gender <u>discrimination</u> (A) <u>can</u> (B) <u>eliminated</u> (C) <u>through</u> (D) education.
questions.explain: Lỗi ở C: bị động với modal cần 'be' → can be eliminated.

questions.q:
Find the underlined part that needs correction.
In the past, <u>many</u> (A) women <u>were</u> (B) not <u>allowed</u> (C) <u>vote</u> (D).
questions.explain: Lỗi ở D: be allowed + to V → were not allowed to vote.

questions.q:
Find the underlined part that needs correction.
<u>Equal</u> (A) pay <u>should be offering</u> (B) to <u>both</u> (C) men and women <u>for</u> (D) the same job.
questions.explain: Lỗi ở B: 'equal pay' được trao → bị động should be offered (không dùng V-ing).

questions.q:
Find the underlined part that needs correction.
<u>Equality</u> (A) job opportunities must be <u>given</u> (B) to everyone <u>who</u> (C) is <u>qualified</u> (D).
questions.explain: Lỗi ở A: trước danh từ 'job opportunities' cần tính từ → Equal job opportunities.

questions.q:
Find the underlined part that needs correction.
Housework <u>should</u> (A) be <u>shared</u> (B) <u>equal</u> (C) <u>between</u> (D) husbands and wives.
questions.explain: Lỗi ở C: bổ nghĩa cho động từ 'be shared' cần trạng từ → equally.

questions.q:
Find the underlined part that needs correction.
<u>Discriminate</u> (A) against women <u>in</u> (B) the workplace <u>must</u> (C) be <u>stopped</u> (D).
questions.explain: Lỗi ở A: chủ ngữ phải là danh từ → Discrimination against women in the workplace must be stopped.

questions.q:
Find the underlined part that needs correction.
Many girls are <u>encouraged</u> (A) <u>to study</u> (B) science, so more women <u>may be</u> (C) <u>employ</u> (D) as engineers in the future.
questions.explain: Lỗi ở D: may be + V3 → may be employed.

questions.q:
Choose the sentence that is closest in meaning to the given sentence.
They should give women more chances to become leaders.
options: Women should be gave more chances to become leaders.
Women should be given more chances to become leaders.
More chances should give women to become leaders.
Women should give more chances to become leaders.
questions.explain: Chuyển bị động với modal: should + be + given. Các phương án khác sai dạng động từ hoặc sai nghĩa (phụ nữ trao cơ hội).

questions.q:
Choose the sentence that is closest in meaning to the given sentence.
Nobody can do this job without good physical strength.
options: Good physical strength cannot be done without this job.
This job cannot be done without good physical strength.
This job cannot do without good physical strength.
This job can be done without good physical strength.
questions.explain: Câu gốc: không ai làm được việc này nếu thiếu sức khoẻ tốt → This job cannot be done without... Phương án 'can be done' ngược nghĩa (mất phủ định); 'This job cannot do' sai dạng (thiếu be); phương án 'Good physical strength cannot be done...' vô nghĩa.

questions.q:
Choose the sentence that is closest in meaning to the given sentence.
Employers must not pay women less than men for the same work.
options: Women must not pay less than men for the same work.
Women must not be paid less than men for the same work.
Men must not be paid less than women for the same work.
Women must be paid less than men for the same work.
questions.explain: Bị động phủ định: must not be paid. Phương án 'must be paid less' mất phủ định; 'Women must not pay' sai nghĩa (phụ nữ trả tiền); phương án 'Men must not be paid less than women' đổi chỗ nam/nữ.

questions.q:
Choose the sentence that is closest in meaning to the given sentence.
It's a good idea for schools to encourage girls to play sports.
options: Girls should be encouraged to play sports at school.
Girls must be forced to play sports at school.
Girls shouldn't be encouraged to play sports at school.
Schools should be encouraged by girls to play sports.
questions.explain: 'It's a good idea ...' = lời khuyên → should; bị động: Girls should be encouraged to... 'must be forced' sai nghĩa (bắt buộc); 'shouldn't' ngược nghĩa; phương án cuối đảo vai.

questions.q:
Choose the sentence that is closest in meaning to the given sentence.
Women were not allowed to vote in many countries 100 years ago.
options: In many countries 100 years ago, women had to vote.
In many countries 100 years ago, women did not want to vote.
In many countries 100 years ago, women could vote freely.
In many countries 100 years ago, women did not have the right to vote.
questions.explain: not allowed to vote = không có quyền bầu cử (not have the right to vote). Các phương án khác sai nghĩa.

questions.q:
Choose the sentence that is closest in meaning to the given sentence.
"I couldn't agree more with you about equal job opportunities," Mark said to Lan.
options: Mark completely agreed with Lan about equal job opportunities.
Mark did not agree with Lan about equal job opportunities at all.
Mark could not agree with Lan about equal job opportunities any longer.
Mark partly agreed with Lan about equal job opportunities.
questions.explain: 'I couldn't agree more' = tôi hoàn toàn đồng ý (cách bày tỏ đồng ý trong Getting Started), không phải không đồng ý.

questions.q:
Choose the sentence that best combines each pair of sentences.
Men and women do the same job. They should receive the same pay.
options: Men and women which do the same job should receive the same pay.
Men and women who do the same job should be received the same pay.
Men and women who do the same job should receive the same pay.
Men and women do the same job should receive the same pay.
questions.explain: Nối bằng đại từ quan hệ who (chỉ người). 'which' dùng cho vật; 'be received' sai nghĩa; phương án cuối thiếu đại từ quan hệ.
questions.review: Lớp 10 · Unit 6 – ôn tập mệnh đề quan hệ who/which (học kĩ ở Unit 8 – Language, Grammar)

questions.q:
Choose the sentence that best combines each pair of sentences.
Girls are encouraged to study science. More women will become engineers.
options: If girls are encouraged to study science, more women will become engineers.
Unless girls are encouraged to study science, more women will become engineers.
If girls encouraged to study science, more women will become engineers.
Although girls are encouraged to study science, more women will become engineers.
questions.explain: Quan hệ điều kiện – kết quả → câu điều kiện loại 1 với bị động: If girls are encouraged... 'If girls encouraged' thiếu are; Unless/Although sai quan hệ nghĩa.

questions.q:
Choose the sentence that best combines each pair of sentences.
Lan wants to be an airline pilot. She is focusing on maths and physics.
options: Lan wants to be an airline pilot although she is focusing on maths and physics.
Lan is focusing on maths and physics, so she wants to be an airline pilot.
Lan wants to be an airline pilot, but she is focusing on maths and physics.
Lan is focusing on maths and physics because she wants to be an airline pilot.
questions.explain: Muốn làm phi công là lí do học tập trung toán, lí → dùng because. although/but chỉ sự tương phản; 'so' đảo ngược quan hệ nhân quả.

questions.q:
Choose the sentence that best combines each pair of sentences.
Men can do this job well. Women can do this job well.
options: Only men can do this job well.
This job can be done well by neither men nor women.
This job can be done well by both men and women.
This job can do well by both men and women.
questions.explain: Cả nam và nữ đều làm tốt → both men and women; bị động: can be done. 'neither...nor' và 'Only men' sai nghĩa; 'can do well' thiếu be.

questions.q: Choose the best option for blank (1).
questions.explain: Collocation 'the same rights and opportunities' = quyền và cơ hội như nhau. occasions/events/moments (dịp, sự kiện, khoảnh khắc) không hợp nghĩa.

questions.q: Choose the best option for blank (2).
questions.explain: were allowed to do = được phép làm. 'let' không dùng ở bị động với to V; prevented đi với from + V-ing; avoided không hợp nghĩa.

questions.q: Choose the best option for blank (3).
questions.explain: Thay cho danh từ chỉ vật 'fields' làm chủ ngữ → that (= which). who chỉ người; what không đứng sau danh từ; whose chỉ sở hữu.

questions.q: Choose the best option for blank (4).
questions.explain: gender gap in pay = chênh lệch thu nhập theo giới.

questions.q: Choose the best option for blank (5).
questions.explain: Sau modal 'should' dùng động từ nguyên mẫu không to → hire (tuyển dụng).

questions.q: Choose the best option for blank (6).
questions.explain: take sth seriously = coi trọng điều gì; ở bị động: was not taken seriously. Cần trạng từ.
questions.review: Lớp 10 · Unit 6 – Communication and Culture, CLIL

questions.q: Choose the best option for blank (7).
questions.explain: World Cup được tổ chức vào năm 1991 → bị động quá khứ đơn: was held.
questions.review: Lớp 10 · Unit 6 – Communication and Culture, CLIL

questions.q: Choose the best option for blank (8).
questions.explain: such as + ví dụ = chẳng hạn như. 'top players such as Megan Rapinoe'.
questions.review: Lớp 10 · Unit 6 – Communication and Culture, CLIL

questions.q: Choose the best option for blank (9).
questions.explain: qualify for a tournament = giành quyền tham dự giải. achieve/win không đi với 'for' theo nghĩa này; succeed đi với 'in'.
questions.review: Lớp 10 · Unit 6 – Communication and Culture, CLIL

questions.q: Choose the best option for blank (10).
questions.explain: Bị động với modal: should + be + V3 → should be treated fairly and (be) paid... song song với 'paid'.
questions.review: Lớp 10 · Unit 6 – Communication and Culture, CLIL
